articles.description: As air pollution continues to trouble Delhi-NCR, Gurugram is preparing to tighten vehicle emission checks. The district administration has announced a 'No PUC, No Fuel' rule under which vehicles without a valid Pollution Under Control certificate will not be given petrol, diesel or CNG. In the first phase, 300 ANPR cameras will be installed at petrol pumps from November 15, 2026, to verify vehicles' registration details and PUC status.
